analysis: Examined docs-only changes. The docs/developer/test.md hunk at head 142-153 replaces the base 142-146 cache policy. Old policy: dev/main/master pushes save; a PR saves only when nothing was restored. New policy: only dev/master pushes save; PRs restore their base entry and save nothing. Removing PR saves reduces cache-poisoning surface from PR builds, so it is not a regression. The same hunk adds the MiMo audio gate (testNativeAudioRelease): it runs only when MIMO_AUDIO inputs change (scripts/ci-component-paths.py) and on every master push. This is conditional test selection; unrelated PRs skip a native gate. That is a CI coverage and availability consideration, not a threat-model asset change. The master-push full run and path classification preserve it, though classifier correctness was not visible. The build.md head unit (lines 490-678) is unchanged surrounding text about review routing, release, Flint, Gemma and Qwen builds. The changed build.md ranges (170-174 cached CMake reuse via a universal.complete marker plus a version check; 273-277 push routing admission; 299-382 the new CI Caching section) appear only in the truncated patch excerpt and are not in visible units. For integration: verify that the CMake tool-cache reuse keeps checksum verification, or rely on image provenance; the marker plus version check is weaker than a checksum if the runner cache is writable by untrusted jobs. Also verify that push cache saves on Darkbloom runners are limited to admitted branches, per the CI Caching section. These concern supply chain for the signed provider artifact (T-013/T-054, A-017), but the source is not visible here. No runtime provider, attestation, encryption or cache-crypto (T-041) behavior changed in the reviewed units.
